text:
maria: noticing a burst of mTLS failures from apac services to eu internal endpoints after today's RBAC tighten. logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied + incomplete cert chain on the server side. anyone seen this pattern?

tony: saw same at ~11:02 UTC. sample log: 
`keystore: Decrypt failed principal=arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-apac err=AccessDenied`
`ingress: verify_error: unable to get local issuer`

nina: rotator promoted new intermediate in eu at 10:58 and removed old alias. looks like regional alias caches didn't pick up the alias swap for ~6m. if keystore principals were removed in RBAC change at the same time, unwraps failed and handshakes dropped.

sre-oncall: mitigation options: re-add role to key policy, force rotator flush, or fail traffic to a canary pool. prefer non-privileged fix first.

maria: try flush/force-redispatch for rotator in apac and test kms:Decrypt from an assumed role.

tony: flushed cache + re-published alias -> verified Decrypt success for assumed role -> handshake errors fell from ~18/min to 1/min in 4m.

audit-bot: Audit slice 10:50-11:10 UTC: events=[ev-3401,ev-3402], principals observed=[rol-keystore-apac, rotator-svc], results=[AccessDenied, Success].

maria: follow-ups: 1) sec to run KMS key policy inventory and add cross-region allowlist pattern for short cutovers (owner: sec). 2) rotator: add pre-cutover parity check + regional cache invalidate (owner: nina). 3) RBAC runbook: include kms:Decrypt canary test and wait-window (owner: tony).

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-2293: "keystore alias cache parity & RBAC canary" assigned to [sec, nina, tony].

sre-oncall: monitoring for 60m. reopen if handshake rate >2% for 5m.

maria: thanks everyone, closing thread unless new errors pop up.
